name: jet
_note: Jet (Rafid Ahsan) is a UCI engine in C++ with NNUE eval. The NNUE file `hexadecane_512_v2.net` is bundled in the repo (src/) and embedded into the binary at build time via -DNNFILE — no external download needed. The perft handler insists on the `perft depth N` syntax: `perft N` directly falls through to a hard-coded depth 6, so we always pass `perft depth {depth}`. The engine only supports 1 search thread (UCI option Threads max=1), so only single-no-cache is defined. Min Hash = 8 MB; clamped silently if a smaller value is passed.
